Our Vision

Building More Than a Home

Built to Live In. Shared to Learn From.

Sustainabox started with a simple question:

Could a shipping container become a home we'd actually want to live in?

The answer wasn't found in a YouTube video or a set of plans. It came through years of research, design, construction, problem solving, and learning — one decision at a time.

Along the way, we realized something bigger.

The world doesn't need another picture-perfect container home. It needs honest information from people who have actually built one.

Too many alternative housing projects are sold as simple, inexpensive, or turnkey. The reality is more nuanced. Every project involves trade-offs, unexpected challenges, and hundreds of decisions that can save — or cost — thousands of dollars.

That's why Sustainabox exists.

We're building a place where builders, homeowners, dreamers, and curious travelers can learn from real experience instead of marketing.

Today that includes a place to stay, educational walkthroughs, consulting, and practical resources. Tomorrow it will grow into a larger ecosystem of courses, tools, design resources, AI-powered planning assistants, community, and partnerships that make alternative housing more approachable for everyone.

We don't claim to have all the answers. We simply believe that sharing what we've learned — both the successes and the mistakes — helps others build better.

Our Principles

Build with intention.

Every decision should have a purpose.

Share what works — and what doesn't.

Real experience is more valuable than polished marketing.

Design for resilience.

Homes should be comfortable, durable, adaptable, and prepared for change.

Keep learning.

Every project teaches something worth passing on.

This is only the beginning.

Sustainabox isn't just the home we built. It's the community, knowledge, and tools we're building next.

Our goal isn't to build hundreds of container homes.
It's to help thousands of people build better ones.
